The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple #NAME? errors in cells H46 through L47. This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, incorrect function syntax, or missing references. While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the final statistical calculations (EXPECTED_STATS) did not match the expected numeric values due to these formula evaluation failures.
